name: Minesweeper
lede: The Windows classic, rebuilt from scratch in the browser.
summary: The Windows classic, rebuilt from scratch in the browser with a mint palette. Twenty bombs, flags, and the rules you remember.
description: Minesweeper, the Windows classic, rebuilt from scratch in the browser with a mint palette. Twenty bombs, flags, and the rules you remember.

items.title: Check a cell
items.text: A checked cell shows how many bombs are around it.

items.title: Flag the bombs
items.text: Flag the cells you think are hiding one. You can unflag them too.

items.title: Win or lose
items.text: Check a bomb and you lose. Flag all twenty and you win.

screenshot.alt: Minesweeper mid-game: a mint-coloured board with numbered cells and red flags.

aside: My mom's favorite game, and mine too.
